clips.text: I am extremely grateful for your loving letter.
I take life as a whole and I am incapable of viewing it in bits and pieces; it is already the whole but because it has been viewed in fragments for so long it has become perverted.

There is no politics, no morality, no religion; there is life, there is God, whole and unfragmented It has to be sought, recognized and lived in all its forms, therefore I shall continue to speak on all its forms.
And this is only the beginning.
Answering journalists is just preparing the ground All paths lead to one end - certain friends might take some time to understand this truth.
As things are, this delay in understanding the truth is unavoidable, but seekers of truth won't be afraid - courage is the first condition in the search for truth.
Remember, as long as spirituality does not become a philosophy of the whole life it proves impotent, and only escapists will take shelter behind it.
